title: QA Engineer – Salesforce & Enterprise Applications
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer – Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12.30 PM IST – 9.30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable.
- Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior.

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation.
- Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems.
- Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization.
- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation.
- Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness.
- Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces.
- Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling.
- Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer.
- 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
- 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications.
- 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing.
- 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools.
- 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing.
- 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
- 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices.

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail.
- Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills.
- Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English.
- Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins.
- Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
- Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams.
- Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes.

About The Role

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

title: Robotics Software Test Engineer (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
At Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Inc., Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots. And as the market leader with 75,000+ collaborative robots (cobots) already installed worldwide, we’re well on the way to achieving it. We employ 1000+ people in offices across North America, South America, Europe and Asia and we’re growing all the time. Our team is made up smart, creative people working at the forefront of automation. Together we find innovative solutions to some of the most important manufacturing issues facing businesses today. We dare to do what others find impossible- working with advanced technologies to change in the way businesses operate , so if you’re looking to build your career with a ground-breaking technology company in dynamic environment with career advancement UR is the place for you.

 Our Purpose 

At Teradyne Robotics, including Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), our mission is simple:Automation for Anyone. Anywhere.

Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots. With more than 100,000 collaborative robots deployed worldwide, Universal Robots leads the global market in collaborative automation while MiR provides cutting-edge autonomous mobile robots that transform internal logistics.

Together we enable manufacturers of all sizes to automate, improve productivity, and empower people through robotics.

Opportunity Overview

Do you want to ensure the quality and safety of software powering the world’s leading collaborative robots?

Are you passionate about testing complex robotic systems and working closely within an international team? Then you might be our next Senior Software Test Engineer.

We are currently looking for an experienced  Software Tester  to join our global R&D organization, working closely with our teams in Denmark. You will become part of a growing setup in India, collaborating daily with highly skilled colleagues across locations.

 Designing the future 

Universal Robots is the world’s market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), developing solutions that transform the way work is done across industries.

In this role, you will contribute directly to the quality and reliability of robot platform and its core components. You would be responsible for testing the core operating system components of the Robot, including networking features, firewall features etc. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and usability.

We are looking for a Backend Test engineer with strong Python automation skills who enjoys working close to the product and the code. You should be comfortable combining hands-on manual testing with Linux Based platforms using Python-based automated testing, while also bringing a strong understanding of ROS. If you are motivated by improving product quality through robust test coverage, fast feedback loops, and close collaboration with developers, this could be the right role for you.

Responsibilities

- Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot 
- Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases 
- Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability 
- Contribute to and improve test frameworks 
- Help define effective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup 
- Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software) 

Qualification, Experience, Skills And Educational Background

To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands-on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create effective tests that increase quality and confidence.

Skills Required

- 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role 
- Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI. 
- Experience with Penetration testing 
- Experience with API Testing 
- Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks. 
- Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman) 
- Proficient with linux environment and linux commands 
- Linux networking stack + systemd (services, journald, network namespaces) 
- Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests. 
- Hands-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software-hardware solutions 
- Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests 
- Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes 
- Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools 
- Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design effective test coverage 
- Experience working in agile or scrum environments 

It Will Be Considered An Advantage If You Have

- Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols 
- Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables) 
- Experience building or improving test automation frameworks 
- Hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks such as labgrid, bench hardware, networked power for automated power-cycling, serial console capture, etc. 
- Automating through the robot's own interfaces (Dashboard Server, RTDE, the primary/secondary/real-time client ports, URScript) 
- Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, pipelines, and build servers 
- Knowledge of safety standards and regulations relevant to robotics or industrial systems 

Communication Skills

- Strong communication and collaboration skills and fluency in English 
- Experience working with distributed and international teams 
- Working across teams and locations 
- You will be part of a setup where engineers in India and Denmark work closely together. 
- This requires: 
- Clear and conscientious communication 
- Ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute across team boundaries
